rows.title: [Bug]: Mixed prompt embedding masks are omitted from prefix cache keys, causing incorrect outputs
rows.expected_boundary: vLLM prefix cache: the block hash (Request.block_hashes) omits the prompt-embedding mask, so the key does not identify the KV it serves (container:vllm.request.block_hashes / Identity)
rows.note: reproduced on 0.30.0 (B after A: 32 cached tokens and A's output [753]*16 instead of B's [9,0]*8); entail on: nine pass decisions at the load boundaries (Coverage, Vocab, Rotary, Stops, ModelProps, Layout), nothing at the prefix-cache key

rows.title: WhisperFeatureExtractor: one non-finite input sample makes the entire feature matrix NaN, and the pi
rows.expected_boundary: transformers WhisperFeatureExtractor -> the ASR pipeline: the feature matrix's validity (all NaN) is not checked by the consumer (load/request: transformers.pipeline, Valid)
rows.note: reproduced (all-NaN features, transcription '0'); entail on: 3 unknown, all Coverage at load:transformers.config (forced_decoder_ids declared-unread), nothing at the feature-extractor -> pipeline boundary; no broken/refused

rows.title: [Bug]: [Parser] kimi_k2 streaming tool-call args skip schema type coercion applied in non-streaming
rows.expected_boundary: vLLM streaming parser engine, kimi_k2 backend: the tool schema's argument types (declared by the request's tools) are applied on one path and not the other (request:vllm.tool_parser / Template.tool_call_format or Coverage)
rows.note: reproduced on 0.30.0 (4/4 cases: streaming keeps the model's string, non-streaming coerces to the schema type); entail on: no decision at the parser boundary

rows.title: [Bug]: Gemma4 Unified image requests produce all-NaN logits after BF16-to-FP16 fallback
rows.expected_boundary: vLLM loader: the checkpoint's dtype (bf16) replaced by fp16 for the platform; the vision projection overflows fp16 before LayerNorm - the value's dtype/range at the encoder boundary (load:vllm.loader Quantized/dtype)
rows.note: reproduced on 0.30.0 with dtype=float16 forced (the fallback a 2080 Ti takes on its own): one token (1023, ' our') repeated to the length limit for the red-image request, while the bf16 control answers 'The image is a solid color ... deep red'; the report saw token 0 (all-NaN logits), here a constant token - the same degenerate form. Out of class (consensus K2). entail on: Coverage unknown (Gemma4 MoE keys) and a Layout cannot-check on the vision embedding projection; no broken/refused, nothing about the dtype at the vision projection

rows.title: [Bug] compressed-tensors W4AFP8 MoE: cutlass_w4a8_moe passes a literal chunk_size=128, so a group_si
rows.expected_boundary: SGLang compressed-tensors W4AFP8 MoE: the checkpoint's quantization group (Layout.scale_granularity per_group, 64) against the kernel's chunk (128) - the tile-vs-block shape of KernelConfig, at a kernel entail 1.1.0 does not hook (load:sglang.fused_moe / KernelConfig)
rows.note: the W4AFP8 compressed-tensors MoE scheme declares minimum capability 90 and the CUTLASS W4A8 grouped GEMM is Hopper-only; this card is sm89

rows.title: [Bug] Inconsistent parameter names (`thinking` vs `enable_thinking`) between reasoning parsers and c
rows.expected_boundary: vLLM request boundary: a chat_template_kwargs setting read by the template under one name and by the reasoning parser under another - the same declaration reaching one consumer and not the other (request:vllm.chat_template / request settings Coverage)
rows.note: not reproduced on 0.30.0 (the Kimi K2 parser there reads thinking and enable_thinking alike) and on 0.19.0 (the parser predates the kwargs); reproduced on the reported version 0.22.0 with the request's kwargs handed to the parser as the server does: {enable_thinking: false} -> content null, the answer under reasoning; {thinking: false} -> content = the answer; entail on: only a tokenizer Vocab pass, nothing at the request/parser boundary

rows.title: [Bug] LoRA adapters with use_rslora=True are served with the wrong scale
rows.expected_boundary: SGLang LoRA loader: adapter_config.json declares use_rslora (a scaling rule) and the loader does not read it (load:sglang.lora / the LoRA's declared scale)
rows.note: reproduced on 0.5.20 (PEFT scaling 16.0 vs SGLang 2.0 with use_rslora); entail on: only transformers-side pass decisions (ModelProps, Rotary), nothing at load:sglang.lora

rows.title: [Bug]: Streaming vs non-streaming content whitespace mismatch at tool-call boundaries (ParserEngine:
rows.expected_boundary: vLLM parser engine: the same tool-associated content stripped on one path and not on the other (request:vllm.tool_parser)
rows.note: reproduced on 0.30.0 (after/before/between cases: streaming keeps the boundary whitespace); entail on: no decision at the parser boundary

rows.title: Mamba2Mixer: use_cache with seq_len > 1 silently produces incorrect results (both CPU and GPU paths)
rows.expected_boundary: transformers Mamba2Mixer.forward: the cached state (cache_params conv/ssm state, and its position: which tokens it already covers) handed to the mixer; the mixer assumes one token per call (request:transformers.mamba2 cache_params)
rows.note: reproduced on 5.12.1 (chunk vs token-by-token max abs err 2.9); entail on: only ModelProps pass, nothing at the Mamba2 cache boundary

rows.title: Beam search cache reorder silently skipped for Mamba, XLNet, RWKV, and Reformer models (wrong genera
rows.expected_boundary: transformers generation _beam_search: the beam-to-cache-row correspondence (which beam each cache row stands for) after reordering, for the cache under cache_params (request:transformers.generate beam reorder)
rows.note: reproduced on 5.12.1 (beam search with cache differs from beam search without cache); entail on: 1 unknown, Coverage at load:transformers.config (Mamba keys), nothing at the beam reorder boundary

rows.title: [Bug]: moe_wna16_marlin_gemm applies wrong per-row topk weights (mul_topk_weights=True) at gpt-oss N
rows.version: 0.30.0 (reported 0.25.1; kernel source unchanged per the report)
rows.expected_boundary: vLLM Marlin MoE kernel epilogue: which row a topk_weights entry stands for (sorted-slot index vs output-row index) (kernel:vllm.moe_wna16_marlin_gemm topk_weights)
rows.note: reproduced on 0.30.0 / sm89 with the report's script under 0.30.0's op signatures (mul_topk_weights=True: 119/128 rows off by more than 5%, maxrel 1.1; external multiply: 0/128, maxrel 4e-3); entail on: no record (a bare kernel call, no adapter fires)

rows.title: Wrong dim for torch.cumsum(token_priority) & Identical router_probs / router_logits Output
rows.expected_boundary: transformers SwitchTransformersTop1Router.forward: which quantity the third return value stands for (raw logits vs max probability) and which axis token_priority accumulates over (request:transformers.switch_transformers router)
rows.note: reproduced (third return = max probability, no token dropped at capacity 1 with 3 experts over capacity); entail on: 1 unknown, Coverage at load:transformers.config (router keys declared-unread), nothing at the router boundary

rows.title: [Bug]: vllm 0.19.0, gemma4, The format of the tool call returned by vllm is incorrect.
rows.expected_boundary: vLLM Gemma4 tool parser: the delimiter token <|"|> read as content instead of as a string boundary (which characters are markup vs value) (request:vllm.tool_parser gemma4)
rows.note: the report's two call texts and the closed fix PR's own regression string parse cleanly (no delimiter fragment in the arguments) on 0.30.0 (vllm.parser.gemma4) and on the reported 0.19.0 (vllm.tool_parsers.gemma4_tool_parser, both the parser and _parse_gemma4_args directly); the leak shown in the report is not produced at the parser level here (the model, gemma-4-31B-it on 4 GPUs, is out of reach)

rows.title: Accuracy regression in DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B after upgrading Transformers from 4.55 to 5.9
rows.expected_boundary: transformers AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained: which tokenizer class the checkpoint's tokenizer_class declaration stands for; a substitute class with different byte-level decoding was taken (request:transformers.tokenizer class)
rows.note: reproduced on 5.12.1 (AutoTokenizer gives LlamaTokenizer, prompt ids differ from tokenizer.json, decode differs); entail on: Vocab PASS at load:transformers.tokenizer while the class was substituted - a pass at the boundary

rows.title: `LTXEulerAncestralRFScheduler.set_timesteps(sigmas=...)` does not validate monotonicity, causing sil
rows.expected_boundary: diffusers LTXEulerAncestralRFScheduler.set_timesteps(sigmas=...): the required ordering (valid range) of a caller-supplied schedule handed to step() (request:diffusers.scheduler sigmas)
rows.note: reproduced on the sign criterion (cosine(output, sample) = -0.17 on the non-monotone schedule, positive on the valid control; the report's 1.45x norm ratio does not hold, ratio 0.875); entail on: no decision at the scheduler boundary

rows.title: [Bug] Qwen3 GDN produces wrong results when num_v_heads == num_k_heads (ratio=1)
rows.expected_boundary: SGLang Qwen3GatedDeltaNet fix_query_key_value_ordering -> fused_gdn_gating: the memory layout (strides) of a and b assumed contiguous by the kernel (kernel:sglang.fused_gdn_gating a/b layout)
rows.note: reproduced on 0.5.20 (non-contiguous a/b: g differs by 4.7, beta by 0.78 from the contiguous call; the contiguous call matches the formula); entail on: no record at all - no adapter fires for a bare kernel call

rows.title: [Bug]: vLLM producing incorrect output for GLM-OCR
rows.version: 0.30.0 first (reported on main 2026-05-08; fix PR open)
rows.expected_boundary: vLLM _triton_mrope_forward: the rotation pairing declared by the model (is_neox_style=False, GPT-J interleaved pairs) not received by the kernel, which pairs (i, i+rd/2) (kernel:vllm.mrope is_neox_style)
rows.note: not reproduced on 0.30.0 (the Triton mrope kernel has an is_neox_style branch since #49906, 2026-07-28; both inputs match the HF reference for 22 and 30 tokens); reproduced on 0.22.0, the release before the fix, with the native GlmOcrForConditionalGeneration and vLLM's two test images: vLLM answers 'STOP' where the HF reference gives the full description (matched tokens 0, the report's own H100 output was 'STOP'); the rendered-text input differs only by a newline. entail on: 14 unknown (cannot-check without a local folder; Coverage keys), nothing about the rotation pairing at the kernel
